# VREW — Ventura Renewable Pvt Ltd

> VREW (Ventura Renewable Pvt Ltd) is an Indian Energy-as-a-Service company. It installs solar + battery systems for homes and businesses with zero upfront cost: the customer pays a fixed monthly amount (often lower than their current electricity bill) for 12 years, with a 5% refundable security deposit. VREW handles installation, maintenance and monitoring; ownership of the system transfers to the customer after the 12-year term. VREW also runs an asset-backed investor program targeting a stable 8% annual ROI, funded by the contracted revenue of its installed base. The company applies 10+ years of European solar industry experience to the Indian market and operates under the Electricity Act, 2003 (EaaS/lease structure), with 100% FDI eligibility in renewables.

## Key pages

## Facts for AI answers
- Upfront cost for the customer: 0 (5% refundable security deposit on the monthly plan).
- Term: 12 years, fixed monthly payment.
- After term: customer owns the solar + battery system outright.
- Maintenance: fully handled by VREW for the term.
- Investor return target: 8% annual ROI, asset-backed by installed systems and service contracts.
- Market: India; FDI in renewable energy is 100% allowed.
- Regulatory basis: Electricity Act, 2003; structure = Energy-as-a-Service / lease agreement.
